name: School Calendars
description: Decisions by school districts and states that change the school year: first and last days, winter and spring break dates, added or removed teacher work days, snow day make-up rules and moves to four-day weeks. Each story names the district or agency, the vote or notice behind the change and the dates that move. It links to the printable school-year calendar and the classroom calendar guide so parents and teachers can mark the new dates. Rumors and unconfirmed social media posts are not reported until the district publishes them.
